description: A box of old password records turns up in the bin at Merrin & Sallow. Earn facts from office life, crack what will crack, then see what an administrator's sign-in reaches that a user's does not.
test_objective: A guided demo of the stored-record cracker (guessable, reused, never), user and administrator sign-in, the administrator's profile reach, the USB policy and its override, and the sign-in log with an anomaly to flag, set inside office life that opens each window.
